games.name: Blockate
games.desc:
Blockate is a sandbox building game where you can create worlds, or play them. In Blockate, you're able to create worlds and build in those worlds with blocks. You can use different shapes, colors, materials, and many things to build up your world. You can also have friends play your worlds, and even help build them.

Controls: 
Q - Toggle Spectator, Building, and Delete mode.
Shift + Q and Shift + E - Swap color
F and G - Change shape
Z and X - Change material
Alt - Copy block's properties
C - Toggle Main Menu
V - Toggle World Menu
U - Open Sticker Wheel
Say !cmds for a list of commands.

games.name: surf
games.desc:
HOW TO SURF:
1. Board the surf parallel to the surface
2. Look straight towards the end of the surf
3. Hold A on the right side of a surf (   /\ A)
4. Hold D on the left side of a surf (D /\   )
5. DO NOT press W while surfing.
6. Look towards the spine to move up the surf
7. Look towards the bottom to move down the surf
8. At the end of the surf, flick towards the spine to launch yourself
    across the gap and air strafe to the next surf

How to air strafe:
1. Hold D while turning right.
2. Hold A while turning left.
3. DO NOT press W while in the air.

Please help teach new players how to play the game!

Say !tutorial for a text-based tutorial.
